messages:
Mike P: Quick sync — GovCloud partner wants a joint announcement + marketplace listing. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and KMS BYOK with an HSM option. Can we get a readiness ETA? Also they require an embargoed press date (two weeks).

Lina S: For SAML: we need their IdP metadata and test SP endpoints. How about a test window next Tue? For SCIM: we'll need attribute mapping (name, email, org).

Raj K: On KMS/HSM: partner prefers PKCS#11 with BYOK. We support keywrap w/ KMS v2 but HSM path needs a quick validation. I can run a compatibility test but need partner certs + sample key material. ETA 4-5 business days after we get samples.

Ava L: Legal: we'll need a joint press approval form and mutual embargo NDA addendum. Don't publish anything until sign-off. I can draft the addendum if you share the press date.

Mike P: Thanks. Can someone own the engineering checklist and coordinate the dry run? I'll schedule partner call. Draft checklist below — fill gaps and I'll send invite.

Mike P: ```
- Obtain partner IdP metadata and certs
- Exchange SP metadata from our side
- SCIM attribute mapping + test users (5)
- Validate SCIM group sync and delta endpoints
- BYOK flow: sample wrapped key + PKCS#11 test harness
- HSM validation: attestations + latency profile
- Legal: embargo addendum signed
- Marketing: draft joint announcement copy for review
```

Raj K: Added: need to confirm SCIM: group sync rate limit and delta support. Also clarify SAML assertions (are they sending eduPerson or custom role claims?).

Lina S: Also note SCIM bulk create edge-case we saw with VaultGrid partner — include user->service account mapping doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/scim-mapping

deploy-bot: Reminder: there's a Dedicated infra maintenance window on Wed 03:00-05:00 UTC — may affect dry run if we pick that slot.

Mike P: OK aiming Wed 16:00 UTC for dry run. Lina, Raj, Ava, can you confirm? :thumbsup:

Lina S: ✅ works for me.

Raj K: Works for me.

Ava L: I'll be there.
